core.headline: 2-bed mid-terrace, Wren Close, Dartford – Shared Ownership
core.summary: 40% share £130,000 (full market value £325,000), rent £487 per month on the unsold share. Mid-terrace house with rear garden and two parking spaces. Leasehold, 990 years remaining, service charge £312 per year.
core.listing:
Shared Ownership: £130,000 for a 40% share. Full market value £325,000. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. Leasehold, 990 years remaining. Ground rent is peppercorn per year. Service charge £312 per year (2026/27 estimate).

Mid-terrace house with two bedrooms, one bathroom and one reception room. Gas central heating. EPC rating B.

Rear garden. Driveway providing two parking spaces.

Council Tax band C (Dartford Borough Council). Construction is standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Broadband FTTC. Good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks.

Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.

Shared ownership eligibility criteria apply. The housing association has an 8-week nomination period on resale.
